Learn the B-Team bottom game, including how to use wrestling concepts, turtling, heisting, and more for a comprehensive system 

  • Force your opponents into a new style of grappling with stand ups, 4 point positions, turtle position, and more used to create action
  • See new positions that can revolutionize your bottom game, including the reverse Z guard and the false half guard
  • Craig is one of the most popular instructors in the world, with ADCC Medals & sustained elite competition success
  • Attack throws and submissions, with options for reversals, leg locks, back takes, and more across 6-volumes 


Combine Wrestling And Jiu-Jitsu With Stand Ups, Heists, Submissions, and More - Develop A Dangerous, Effective Bottom Game With These No-Gi Guard Concepts & Systems From Australian Grappling Superstar Craig Jones!



Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Join Aussie grappling star Craig Jones as he teaches you how to fight from bottom using the most modern and successful style of guard play that combines submissions, wrestling, and more into a dangerous & effective system for attack. This 6-part series has a full breakdown of the no-gi guard that will help you score more and frustrate opponents with this new approach to the bottom position.

The B-Team bottom game is based around a few simple concepts that Craig breaks down for you, helping you understand the philosophies that his team uses to train for elite competition success. With those lessons, go through Craig’s ranges of guard and see how you can best set up double legs, single legs, ashi entries, and more using his style of forcing action with threats of standing up.

As no-gi grappling continues to evolve, merge your grappling with important wrestling lessons and positions that can start helping you win on the mat. Combine these lessons with rear body locks, turtle position, 4-points, and more - Craig explains each position in full detail so you can confidently work from bottom and give yourself the highest chance of success.

With systems for the long range open guard, short range open guard, half guard, and innovative systems for Craig’s reverse Z guard and false half guard, there is a ton of knowledge being shared here that can transform your game. Start learning from one of grappling’s most effective bottom players with Craig’s modern take on classic positions.

products.title: The B Team Top Game: How to Work Against Seated Guards, Supine Guards, and Those Trying to Stand Up by Craig Jones
products.body:
Learn the B-Team top game, including how to work against seated guards, supine guards, and those trying to stand up 

  • Force errors and exploit common mistakes with Craig’s techniques for passing - including stacks, torreandos, leg drags, and more
  • See some of the best ways to clear out of dangerous leg entanglements with leg locking master Craig’s advice
  • Craig is one of the most popular instructors in the world, with ADCC Medals & sustained elite competition success
  • This six-part series will help you understand how to approach and think about playing top in no-gi, and how you can begin to enforce your rhythm and method against your opponents

Redefine No-Gi Guard Passing With Australian Grappling Superstar Craig Jones As He Explains His System For Passing Against Tough Guards And Disengaging Dangerous Positions


What Will You Learn?

See your top game get better than ever with no-gi grappling star Craig Jones’s six-part series on guard passing concepts and techniques that you can use to better your skills. With coaching on how to break down the guard, including how he approaches seated guard, supine guard, and opponents determined to stand up, Craig shows a complete guard passing class for grapplers of all levels.

Use conceptual lessons like how to score your passes through fatigue, and how important the hip pocket is to every pass, as Craig shows you ways to make guard passing a lot simpler through easy adjustments. With drills and techniques built on a strong base of experience in competition against the best, Craig can show you what really works when you want to get to a dominant position and what mistakes people are commonly making.

Craig Jones is one of the most popular grapplers and instructors in the world, with an ADCC medal from 2019 and many elite victories against some of the best in the game. Use Craig’s coaching on leg drags, stacks, torreandos, body locks, and more as he shows you how to approach a dangerous guard and defuse the situation.

Don’t get caught up in those tricky leg entanglements again, Craig explains here on this six-volume series how to avoid those positions and even how to clear from dangerous positions like shin on shin and ashi garami. Combine your techniques into one system with Craig’s help as he shows you all the ways to shut down bottom fighters and be the power top on the mats.

products.title: Power Ride 2.0 by Craig Jones
products.body:
Top half guard is one of the most misunderstood positions in grappling, and few people have turned it into a true pin better than Craig Jones.

  • Craig Jones is a two-time ADCC silver medalist, a black belt under Lachlan Giles and a co-founder of the B-Team, known for breaking down positions in ways nobody else does.
  • In Power Ride 2.0, Jones breaks down his top half guard pinning system: the near side underhook, shutting down the octopus guard, the Quad Lemma setups, and the short darce and head and arm finishes.
  • This isn't just a half guard passing course, it's a complete philosophy on treating top half guard as a pin you can hold, ride and finish from.


What Will You Learn?

Top half guard is one of the most misunderstood positions in grappling, and few people have turned it into a true pin better than Craig Jones.

Craig Jones took silver at ADCC in 2019 and again in 2022, and before that he won the IBJJF No-Gi World Championship as a purple belt. A black belt under Lachlan Giles and a co-founder of the B-Team, he has built his reputation on seeing positions differently from everyone else. Now he's sharing the next chapter of the pinning system he started in the original Power Ride.

Power Ride 2.0 covers the details that make top half guard so hard to escape. You'll learn how to get the near side underhook, ride the hips, kill the bridge and put your opponent in a grey area where they can't recover guard or get out. From there, Jones shows you how to stop the octopus guard, why half guard is the answer, and how to chain the short darce, the kimura, the head and arm choke and the head and arm triangle off the same pin. This isn't just a half guard passing course, it's a complete philosophy on treating top half guard as a pin you can hold, ride and finish from.

Whether you compete in no-gi, train in the gi or just want a more reliable top game, top half guard serves as a home base you can come back to again and again. Jones also shows you how to handle mount when you don't have the underhook, so the system keeps working as the position changes.

The reason it works is simple: instead of rushing to pass, you control the position first and make your opponent carry your weight while you set up your finishes. The Quad Lemma gives you several attacks from one setup, and the live rounds in Volume 5 show you how the whole system holds up against real resistance.

If you've ever wondered why elite grapplers seem happy to stay in top half guard instead of rushing to pass, this course gives you the answer.

Learn how to turn top half guard into a pin your opponents can't escape with Craig Jones.

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 2: Octopus Killer and The Short Darce

  • What Is Half Guard

  • Short Darce Outro

products.title: Systematic Submission Dilemmas: High Level Triangle and Leg Lock Combos by Craig Jones
products.body:
Learn the system Craig Jones uses to combine triangle chokes and leg locking into a devastatingly dangerous submission game

  • See how to lock on triangles from everywhere and create the most leverage possible for full strangulation
  • Study Craig’s genius leg locking transitions and finishes for maximum control and breaking power
  • COMBINE triangle chokes and leg locks to start attacking upper and lower body dilemmas
  • Craig Jones is one of the best no-gi grapplers ever, and one of the most technical and feared submission artists on Earth
  • See the dilemma system in action as Craig breaks down live rolling footage so you can watch the strategy and techniques take life.



Create The Ultimate Submission Dilemma Between Upper and Lower Body With These Triangle and Leg Lock Combos From International Grappling Star & DDS Team Member Craig Jones

Finish Fights With More Technique and Strategy With ADCC Medalist Craig Jones’s Step-by-Step System For Relentlessly Hunting The Submission



Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Craig Jones is BACK with BJJ Fanatics with a super-sized 8-volume instructional series on how to create the ultimate submission danger, using triangles and leg locks together for a dilemma-based system. By combining these two, your opponent will defend one attack only to give you another as you move from technique to technique until you get the finish.

As Craig has evolved from a promising no-gi grappling prospect to an ADCC medalist and one of the best submission hunters ever, he has learned an important truth: As your opponent defends one submission, they will give you access to other parts of the body. If they defend high, go low. They defend low? Go high. Now, this strategy has helped him develop into one of the most active finishers in submission grappling and you can learn how here.

By combining triangles (upper body) and leg locks (lower body), Craig shows how to take your submission game to the next level. He breaks down each submission in detail, including finishing mechanics and the solutions to the major problems of each hold. Then, you’ll learn how to combine the two by playing off of key weaknesses in the defense to each.

Once you have the submission dilemma system in place, Craig shows how to enter into the system from all his most effective positions. Attack leg locks and triangles from top position, open guard, half guard, closed guard, and more, each one giving you full access to the rest of the system. Included in here is real-world examples from some of Craig’s most high profile matches, so you can see the same entries that have worked against elite competition.

See the submission system in action as Craig breaks down live rolling footage from the gym, and shows you his strategy and choices as he goes so you can watch how these moves fit together against resistance. This new 8-volume series will give you a much more dangerous game as you start working off the upper and lower body dilemmas that Craig specializes in.

The Single Greatest Drill To Develop A Strong Inside Heel Hook
